problems_found.problem: Writer flagged this themselves: H1 "看重您的思路，不只看结果" used 您, which follows the spec §13 named per-page example verbatim but conflicts with the same section's own general rule ("no 您 or 你 in any headline") and with zh-register.md §5 rule 5 / §2.7 point 5 (press headlines never use 您; they name the group and let the reader self-select — the register guide is the authority on what reads natural in the Sin Chew education register). Decided in favour of the general no-pronoun rule and the register guide, since the guide's evidence base (13 newspaper sources) is specific and consistent on this point, while the spec's own example reads as an oversight against its adjacent rule.
